privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: This page describes how we collect, use, share, and protect information when you use our services.
privacy.bodySubtitle: Clear, practical information for users and app store review.

content.overview: We value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what data we may collect, why we collect it, and how we handle it across our website and mobile applications.

dataWeCollect.item1: Account and contact information you provide (such as name, email, phone) when you contact us or sign up.
dataWeCollect.item2: Usage information (such as pages viewed and basic device/browser data) for improving performance and reliability.
dataWeCollect.item3: Information you submit through forms, support requests, or chat features.

howWeUse.item1: Provide and operate our services (including customer support).
howWeUse.item2: Improve product experience, performance, and security.
howWeUse.item3: Communicate important updates and respond to inquiries.
howWeUse.item4: Comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms.

content.sharing: We do not sell personal data. We may share information with trusted service providers (for hosting, analytics, and support) only as needed to operate our services, and under appropriate safeguards.
content.security: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.
content.retention: We retain information only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law.
content.children: Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

yourRights.item1: Request access to the personal data we have about you.
yourRights.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
yourRights.item3: Request deletion of your data, where applicable.
yourRights.item4: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

content.changes: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the “Last updated” date on this page.
content.contactPrefix: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

1.description: Specialized ERP solution helping retail businesses efficiently manage multi-channel operations and optimize customer experience.
benefits: Synchronize inventory, pricing, and orders across all sales points (stores, online, social media).
Accurate demand forecasting, detailed inventory management by location, batch, expiry date, minimizing storage costs and stockout risks.

2.title: Manufacturing ERP
2.description: Intelligent manufacturing execution system with deep integration from planning to actual quality control on the factory floor.
benefits: Master Production Schedule (MPS) tool, order allocation, material synchronization. Automatically integrate plans between departments (Spinning, Knitting, Sewing), ensuring optimal capacity and meeting critical path.

1.title: Retail ERP Implementation for Supermarket Chain
1.description: Comprehensive Retail ERP system deployment for supermarket chain with over 200 points of sale, integrating multi-channel management and optimizing customer experience.
1.result: 100% multi-channel data synchronization, 35% reduction in inventory costs, 50% increase in promotion management efficiency
1.content:
National Retail Group is one of Vietnam's largest supermarket chains with over 200 points of sale nationwide. Managing multi-channel operations and synchronizing data between sales points is a major challenge they face.

Initial Challenges

Before implementing ERP, the Group faced many difficulties: inventory data was not synchronized between sales points, high inventory costs, and difficulties in managing multi-channel promotions. The old system could not meet the development needs at large scale.

Solution Deployment

NexaCore deployed a comprehensive Retail ERP solution, integrating all sales points, online systems and social media sales channels into a unified platform. The system was deployed in phases to ensure no disruption to business operations.

Outstanding Features

NexaCore's Retail ERP system integrates advanced features such as real-time inventory management, multi-channel data synchronization, and 360-degree customer management. With AI and Machine Learning technology, the system can forecast demand, optimize pricing and suggest effective promotion strategies.

Impressive Results

After 6 months of deployment, the Group achieved impressive results: 100% multi-channel data synchronization, 35% reduction in inventory costs, and 50% increase in promotion management efficiency. The system helped the Group optimize operations and significantly enhance customer experience.

2.title: Manufacturing ERP Deployment for Textile Factory
2.description: Intelligent Manufacturing ERP system deployment with deep integration from planning to quality control, WIP/FG production management and Barcode system.
2.result: 40% production capacity optimization, 30% reduction in material waste, 25% increase in inventory accuracy
2.content:
Leading Textile Company is one of Vietnam's largest textile manufacturers with complex production processes from spinning, knitting to sewing. Managing and optimizing production processes is a major challenge.

Production Challenges

Before implementing ERP, the factory faced many difficulties: high raw material waste, suboptimal production capacity, and difficulties in quality control. The old system could not meet the requirements for detailed management across each production stage.

Manufacturing ERP Solution

NexaCore deployed a Manufacturing ERP solution with IED Tool and Inspection Tool technology, helping the factory optimize processes from planning to quality control. The system features deep integration with factory floor equipment and detailed management of WIP/FG output.

IED Tool and Inspection Tool Technology

The system integrates the IED (Industrial Engineering Data) tool to help build and manage a standard time library (SMV/SAM/SAH) detailed by design. The Inspection Tool allows error data entry via touch screen and automatically assesses fabric quality based on the number of defects.

Results Exceeded Expectations

After deployment, the factory achieved impressive results: 40% production capacity optimization, 30% reduction in raw material waste, and 25% increase in inventory accuracy. The system helped the factory enhance its competitiveness and meet international standards.

3.title: Budget Management System for Corporation
3.description: Comprehensive Budget Management solution deployment with real-time spending control and detailed variance analysis reporting.
3.result: 45% reduction in overspending, 60% increase in forecast accuracy, 50% improvement in approval speed
3.content:
Multi-industry Corporation with many subsidiaries and different departments needs a centralized and efficient budget management system. Controlling spending and budget allocation is a major challenge.

Budget Management Issues

Before deployment, the Corporation faced many difficulties: frequent overspending, low forecast accuracy, and slow approval processes. The old system could not meet the centralized management requirements for many subsidiaries.

Budget Management Solution

NexaCore deployed a comprehensive Budget Management solution, allowing the Corporation to control spending in real-time and allocate budgets effectively. The system automates approval processes and alerts when there is a risk of overspending.

Real-time Spending Control

The system automates approval processes, reconciles with approved budgets to prevent overspending from the start. All transactions are tracked and alerted immediately when there is a risk of exceeding budget.

Variance Analysis and Reporting

The solution provides in-depth reports comparing actual budgets with forecasts, supporting investment decisions and accurate resource allocation. Visual dashboards help leaders quickly grasp the financial situation.

Successful Results

After deployment, the Corporation achieved impressive results: 45% reduction in overspending, 60% increase in forecast accuracy, and 50% improvement in approval speed. The system helped the Corporation maintain financial discipline and optimize resource utilization efficiency.

7.title: DMS Deployment for FMCG Company
7.description: Comprehensive Distribution Management System (DMS) deployment, digitizing sales processes and distribution channel management, optimizing field operation efficiency.
7.result: 45% increase in market coverage, 35% reduction in dead inventory, 50% improvement in sales team performance
7.content:
Consumer Goods Company is one of Vietnam's largest FMCG manufacturers with a wide distribution network. Managing distribution channels and sales teams is a major challenge.

Distribution Management Challenges

Before deploying DMS, the Company faced many difficulties: low market coverage, high dead inventory, and difficulties in managing sales teams. The old system could not meet real-time management requirements for thousands of sales points.

DMS Deployment

NexaCore deployed a comprehensive DMS system, helping the Company manage sales force, track channel inventory and optimize operational efficiency. The system is integrated with mobile applications for sales teams.

Sales Force Management

DMS helps monitor activities, sales routes and order performance of field sales reps (Sales Reps) via mobile app. The system tracks GPS location, customer visit time and sales results, helping optimize work efficiency.

Channel Inventory Tracking

The system updates inventory, display status, and orders at point of sale/NPP in real-time, reducing stockout risks and dead inventory. Data is automatically synchronized with the central ERP system.

Outstanding Results

After deployment, the Company achieved outstanding results: 45% increase in market coverage, 35% reduction in dead inventory, and 50% improvement in sales team performance. The system helped the Company optimize distribution processes and enhance business efficiency.

8.title: E-commerce Platform Deployment for Fashion Brand
8.description: Powerful E-commerce platform deployment with deep ERP & CRM integration, supporting multi-language, multi-currency and performance optimization.
8.result: 120% increase in online revenue, 40% reduction in order processing time, 65% improvement in user experience
8.content:
International Fashion Brand is one of the world's famous fashion brands with global presence. Developing online sales channels is a top priority to expand markets.

E-commerce Development Needs

Before deploying the E-commerce platform, the Brand faced many difficulties: low online revenue, poor user experience, and difficulties in managing multi-channel orders. The old system could not meet development requirements.

E-commerce Platform Deployment

NexaCore deployed a powerful E-commerce platform, deeply integrated with ERP & CRM, supporting multi-language, multi-currency and performance optimization. The system is customized to fit the Brand's business model.

Deep Integration with ERP & CRM

Orders, inventory, customer information are automatically synchronized, eliminating errors and ensuring accurate sales data. The system automatically updates inventory when new orders arrive and synchronizes customer information with CRM.

Highly Customizable Platform

Allows building unique interfaces and user experiences, meeting complex B2B/B2C business models. The system supports multi-language, multi-currency, and integrates marketing tools (SEO, links).

Spectacular Results

After deployment, the Brand achieved spectacular results: 120% increase in online revenue, 40% reduction in order processing time, and 65% improvement in user experience. The system helped the Brand expand markets and significantly grow online revenue.

NexaCore deployed a comprehensive Budget Management solution, allowing the Corporation to control spending in real-time and allocate budgets effectively. The system automates approval processes and alerts when there is a risk of overspending.

Successful Results

After deployment, the Corporation achieved impressive results: 45% reduction in overspending, 60% increase in forecast accuracy, and 50% improvement in approval speed. The system helped the Corporation maintain financial discipline and optimize resource utilization efficiency.

12.title: Bank Digital Transformation: Successful Data Warehouse Construction
12.excerpt: Commercial Bank successfully built Data Warehouse platform, increasing 70% data analysis speed and improving 80% forecast accuracy.
12.author: NexaCore Team
12.content:
Commercial Bank is one of Vietnam's largest banks with massive data volumes from various systems. Analyzing data and making data-driven decisions is a major challenge.

Data Analysis Challenges

Before building Data Warehouse, the Bank faced many difficulties: data scattered across multiple systems, slow analysis speed, and low forecast accuracy. Data-driven decision making was not effective.

Building Data Warehouse

NexaCore built a centralized Data Warehouse platform, integrating data from all Bank systems. The system is optimized for complex queries and large data analysis.

Impressive Results

After deployment, the Bank achieved impressive results: 70% increase in data analysis speed, 80% improvement in forecast accuracy, and enhanced data-driven decision-making capabilities. The system helped the Bank improve service quality and optimize business operations.

13.title: Cloud Storage Private: Solution for Government Organizations
13.excerpt: Government Agency successfully deployed Cloud Storage Private, achieving 99.99% uptime and 100% compliance with data security regulations.
13.author: NexaCore Team
13.content:
Government Agency handles large amounts of sensitive data and needs a storage solution ensuring maximum security and compliance with strict regulations. Cloud Storage Private is the appropriate choice.

Strict Security Requirements

Government Agency has very high security requirements and needs to comply with data protection regulations. The storage solution must ensure security, availability and complete control.

Cloud Storage Private Deployment

NexaCore deployed Cloud Storage Private solution with an independent storage environment, ensuring compliance with data security regulations. The system is encrypted end-to-end and can only be accessed by authorized parties.

Excellent Results

After deployment, the Agency achieved excellent results: 99.99% uptime, 100% compliance with data security regulations, and 60% reduction in storage costs. The system helps the Agency ensure availability and security of important data.

14.title: DMS Helps FMCG Company Increase 45% Market Coverage
14.excerpt: Consumer Goods Company successfully deployed DMS, increasing 45% market coverage and reducing 35% dead inventory.
14.author: NexaCore Team
14.content:
Consumer Goods Company is one of Vietnam's largest FMCG manufacturers with a wide distribution network. Managing distribution channels and sales teams is a major challenge.

Distribution Management Challenges

Before deploying DMS, the Company faced many difficulties: low market coverage, high dead inventory, and difficulties in managing sales teams. The old system could not meet real-time management requirements.

DMS Deployment

NexaCore deployed a comprehensive DMS system, helping the Company manage sales force, track channel inventory and optimize operational efficiency. The system is integrated with mobile applications for sales teams.

Outstanding Results

After deployment, the Company achieved outstanding results: 45% increase in market coverage, 35% reduction in dead inventory, and 50% improvement in sales team performance. The system helps the Company optimize distribution processes and enhance business efficiency.

15.title: E-commerce Platform: Fashion Brand Increases 120% Revenue
15.excerpt: International Fashion Brand deployed E-commerce platform, increasing 120% online revenue and improving 65% user experience.
15.author: NexaCore Team
15.content:
International Fashion Brand is one of the world's famous fashion brands with global presence. Developing online sales channels is a top priority to expand markets.

E-commerce Development Needs

Before deploying the E-commerce platform, the Brand faced many difficulties: low online revenue, poor user experience, and difficulties in managing multi-channel orders. The old system could not meet development requirements.

E-commerce Platform Deployment

NexaCore deployed a powerful E-commerce platform, deeply integrated with ERP & CRM, supporting multi-language, multi-currency and performance optimization. The system is customized to fit the Brand's business model.

Spectacular Results

After deployment, the Brand achieved spectacular results: 120% increase in online revenue, 40% reduction in order processing time, and 65% improvement in user experience. The system helped the Brand expand markets and significantly grow online revenue.

16.title: Technology Trends 2024: Comprehensive Digital Transformation
16.excerpt: Outstanding technology trends in 2024 include smart ERP, Cloud Storage, Data Warehouse and comprehensive digitalization solutions.
16.author: NexaCore Team
16.content:
2024 sees strong development of digital transformation technologies, with many new trends shaping the future of businesses. Smart ERP solutions, Cloud Storage, and Data Warehouse are becoming important platforms.

Smart ERP with AI

Smart ERP with AI and Machine Learning integration is becoming a major trend. The system can automate processes, forecast trends and optimize business efficiency. Businesses investing in smart ERP will have significant competitive advantages.

Cloud Storage and Data Warehouse

Cloud Storage and Data Warehouse are becoming strategic platforms for businesses wanting to leverage the power of data. These solutions help businesses store, analyze and make data-driven decisions effectively.

Future of Digital Transformation

With the development of new technologies, digital transformation will continue to be a top priority for businesses. Comprehensive digitalization solutions will help businesses enhance competitiveness and develop sustainably in the modern market.

17.title: NexaCore Partners with New Strategic Partners
17.excerpt: NexaCore announces partnership with leading technology partners to expand services and enhance solution quality for customers.
17.author: NexaCore Team
17.content:
NexaCore proudly announces strategic partnerships with leading technology partners in the industry, opening a new chapter in the company's development and innovation journey.

Strategic Partners

Through these partnerships, NexaCore will expand service scope and enhance solution quality for customers. Partners will provide advanced technology and deep expertise to support NexaCore in developing the best solutions.

Benefits for Customers

NexaCore customers will benefit from improved solutions, latest technology and better services. This partnership will help NexaCore better meet customer needs and deliver greater value.

Future Development

With these strategic partnerships, NexaCore will continue to lead in technology innovation and provide the best solutions for customers. The company is committed to investing in development and innovation to deliver long-term value.

18.title: Future ERP Solutions: AI and Machine Learning Integration
18.excerpt: The future of ERP will deeply integrate with AI and Machine Learning to automate processes, forecast trends and optimize business efficiency.
18.author: NexaCore Team
18.content:
The future of ERP is being shaped by deep integration with AI and Machine Learning. Smart ERP solutions will automate processes, forecast trends and optimize business efficiency like never before.

AI and Machine Learning Integration

ERP with AI and Machine Learning can automate complex processes, from production planning to inventory management. The system can learn from historical data and provide smart suggestions to optimize operations.

Forecasting and Optimization

With the ability to analyze big data, smart ERP can forecast market trends, customer demand and potential risks. The system automatically optimizes processes to achieve highest efficiency.

Future of Businesses

Businesses investing in smart ERP will have significant competitive advantages in the modern market. The system will help businesses react quickly to changes, optimize operations and develop sustainably.
